working_title: The Complete Story of Noah (Genesis 5-9) KJV

hook.text: What if obeying God meant building a ship with no rain in sight? Here is Noah's whole story, Genesis five to nine.

close.text: Noah did all that God commanded him, before one drop fell. So what is God asking of you, that you cannot yet see?

segments.text: What if obeying God meant building a ship with no rain in sight? Here is Noah's whole story, Genesis five to nine.

The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them. I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; For it repenteth me that I have made them.
And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark,
For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights;
The Flood Ends: The Raven, the Dove and the Rainbow
Noah did all that God commanded him, before one drop fell. So what is God asking of you, that you cannot yet see?
